task: #169 ws_client.rs client-side Sky.Core.WebSocket subs (sub_subscribe_ws_message/close/error) carry the same over-strict F: Fn(..) -> .. + Send + Sync + 'static bound that #166 fixed on sub_subscribe_stream, for the identical reason (F moved into exactly one detached tokio::spawn task, never shared behind an Arc). Currently unreachable -- no KernelFn variant routes codegen to these symbols yet -- so no fix needed today. Relax to Send + 'static (mirror sub_subscribe_topic's doc-commented rationale) in the SAME commit that first wires a KernelFn arm to these functions, so the wiring commit does not ship exit-0-then-cargo-fail on day one.

task: #170 onSubmit payload classifier (is_definitely_not_callable, #167) does not cover record/tuple/list literal payloads -- only Expr::Ctor and scalar leaves. A record/tuple/list literal onSubmit payload would ALSO be non-callable (HtmlOnSubmit's payload type is genuinely unconstrained per constrain.rs's HtmlEventShape::Raw scheme) but is not classified as such, so it stays on the old wrap-and-call path and would still fail cargo build with the same class of error #167 fixed for bare Ctors.
notes: Found during #167's independent adversarial review. NOT a regression -- this exact shape was ALREADY broken before #167 (no prior working behavior to preserve) and is essentially unreachable in a real Sky.Live app (the view tree pins msg to one concrete type, so a record/tuple/list literal happening to unify with a real onSubmit handler's Msg type is very unlikely in practice). Low priority, not blocking.

task: Non-literal (variable) tuple scrutinee with a COERCING column (string-literal / list / cons): #174 correctly FAIL-CLOSES this to SKY-L0115 (avoiding exit-0-then-cargo-fail via the coercion-free by-value WHOLE match), but Std.Ui.Transform.propsToCss uses `case pair of ( "transform", v ) -> …` (variable scrutinee + string-literal column). So Std.Ui.Transform — and everything importing it (Std.Ui.Animation, 26-ui-showcase, any Transform/Animation user) — fails at skyc. ADD the capability: the variable-scrutinee tuple path must emit per-column coercion (e.g. match on scrutinee.N.as_str() for a String column, slice patterns for List/Cons) like the literal-scrutinee path already does, instead of fail-closing. Mirror the reference native-match per-column coercion (../sky ExprEmitter.hs tuple match).
notes: Found by #175 review (2026-07-13). NOT a regression/SEAL-violation — #174 fail-closes honestly. This is the residual capability beyond #174 (which was scoped to Sky.Test non-coercing columns). Unblocks #175 Animation seal (currently #[ignore]) + is a prerequisite for 26-ui-showcase with #180. Broad: affects any Std.Ui.Transform/Animation importer.
